fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 1999 Regal 176 SEI bowrider with trailer.
findings: Hull sides look fairly clean but the white gelcoat appears slightly flat rather than glossy along the port and starboard sides
Light yellowing and dulling on the white upper deck and bow area
Rear bench and sun pad vinyl look clean overall with some light discoloration in the seams and pleats
Dark carpet in the cockpit shows some light debris and could use a vacuum and freshening
Beige dash panel around the gauges looks a bit dusty
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Regal 176 SEI. It looks well kept, but the white gelcoat on the hull and deck is a little flat in the photos, and a polish plus a vinyl and carpet clean-up would help it pop for buyers. We do pre-sale boat details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
